Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advises L Catterton India Fund on its investment in Nandhana Foods Private Limited

CAM advised on all aspects of the Transaction, including the legal due diligence and the transaction documents.

Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised L Catterton India Fund on its investment in Nandhana Foods Private Limited (the “Company”), by way of a subscription to newly issued equity shares and the acquisition of equity shares from existing shareholders (the “Transaction”).

The Company operates South Indian cuisine restaurants and cloud kitchens and is also engaged in the retail sale of spices and pickles under its own brand.

The transaction team was led by Aditi Manchanda, Saloni Shroff, and Sonakshi Arora, Partners; with support from Geetika Myer, Principal Associate; Deepjoyika Dastidar, Principal Associate — Designate; Kaushik Raichura and Harshvardhan Tripathi, Senior Associates; Shravan Subramanian and Karan Anand, Associates.

Biplab Lenin, Partner; with support from Pratiti Shah, Senior Associate; advised on the regulatory related aspects of the transaction.

Abe Abraham, Partner; with support from Faiza Khan, Principal Associate; and Harshit Chauhan, Associate; advised on the labour related aspects of the transaction.

Swati Sharma, Partner (Head – Intellectual Property); and Arya Tripathy, Partner; with support from Andri Shukla, Principal Associate; Pundreek Dwivedi, Senior Associate; Milind Yadav and Dylan Sharma, Associates; advised on the intellectual property and information technology related aspects of the transaction.
